newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MANAGED CARE SAYS WILL EXCEED EARNINGS FORECAST.
newsitem.headline: MANAGED CARE SAYS WILL EXCEED EARNINGS FORECAST.

text.p: Managed Care SA Limited said on Saturday it expected to make a profit in this financial year and exceed forecast earnings due to business reconstruction.
It said in a statement it would in future focus purely on the hospital-related aspects of managed healthcare, a niche market with above average growth.
"(The company) will be profitable in the current year to 28 February 1997, thus exceeding its pre-listing statement forecast of a break-even position for the year.
"Forecast earnings of 3 cents and 13.4 cents a share respectively for the following two years will also be exceeded," it said.
